verdict.rationale: Angular's own docs state it is a fully featured platform where everything works together with first-party modules for forms. That covers first-party form modules and framework integration, but only as a single marketing-level line. Validation is never mentioned, and there are no API docs or hands-on reports. Missing for 10: evidence of built-in form validation, in-depth forms documentation (reactive/template-driven APIs), independent or hands-on corroboration of the forms modules.
